summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Budget Masse Salariale (CCQ) SPA. 7/7 pytest passed. All 4 SPA tabs render their pages correctly, employee CRUD works, form validation shows errors, computed age/seniority correct, budget augmentations recompute (debounced), hypothesis save persists across reload. No React console errors; only 2 benign a11y warnings about DialogContent aria-describedby.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby (a11y warning in console). Add <DialogDescription> for screen readers.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Add DialogDescription in EmployeeForm to remove Radix a11y console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py exposes /api/hypotheses PUT accepting arbitrary dict (no Pydantic validation). Consider a HypothesesModel for input safety.
_next_number() is not atomic - concurrent creates could yield duplicate employee_numbers. Consider using a MongoDB counters collection with findOneAndUpdate($inc).
DELETE /api/employees on unknown but ObjectId-shaped id returns 404 correctly; PUT on malformed id also returns 404. Good.
compute_section reads e['prime_type'] without fallback; a bad seed value would 500. Consider .get with default.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_UI_Employee via UI; no residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend seeded with 8 employees + default hypotheses on startup. Public URL from frontend/.env is used for all tests. Tab nav works — verified by clicking nav-employees/budget/hypotheses and asserting employees-page/budget-page/hypotheses-page containers render. Budget aug inputs are percent-typed and debounced (~700ms). Hypothesis rates in the form are entered as percent and stored as decimal server-side. There is a race on EmployeesPage load (rows arrive ~1s later), so waits >=1s are needed after nav.
